currentState: OTA inclusion candidate (source-parity verified), not frozen RC and not published
ownerWaiver: Actual Android device playback verification skipped at owner's request on 2026-11-10; waiver does not waive source safety review, mandatory RC release gates, or production evidence.
selectionRationale: All seven candidate file base blobs match the current NOV10 single-source integration branch exactly; transfer only these files instead of merging divergent main/release branches or reintroducing previous fixes.

behavior.autoplay: Viewport-specific activation at 45%/80ms, separate from the unchanged 60%/400ms ad activation

behavior.buffering: Expo Android player minimum buffer 1s and forward target 18s; capped cache 256 MiB
behavior.recovery: One automatic replay, bounded timeout, signed URL refresh with short dedupe/backoff, tappable terminal Retry only
behavior.preserved: Native IMA video ads, per-scope authorization and server signing, account isolation, photo/media rendering, web playback path and existing approved Home/Kingdom/Bible/Health/monetization code
